exercise.name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie face up with your arms stretched past your head.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your arms, shoulders and legs.
Hold that curved shape, legs straight and low, for the time.
exercise.one_line_summary: A hold (one picture): lying face up, low back pressed flat, shoulders curled ~30 deg off the floor, arms straight overhead by the ears, legs straight, together and low (~10 deg off the floor). A shallow banana shape. Rectus abdominis is the target.

setup.target: Pressed into the floor, no gap under the low back.
setup.tolerance: pelvis does not arch off; lumbar flat
setup.why: ACE hollow-body cue: no space between the back and the floor.

setup.target: Straight overhead, biceps by the ears, lifted with the shoulders.
setup.tolerance: arms 160-180 deg overhead in the torso frame
setup.why: ACE: arms reaching overhead, biceps by the ears; library step 1.

setup.target: Straight and together, toes pointed, held low (heels roughly 0.2-0.3 m off the floor).
setup.tolerance: leg line 5-20 deg above the floor
setup.why: Library: legs straight and low. Lower legs = longer lever = harder; they must never drop so low that the back arches.

movement.tolerance: 20-40 deg; shoulder blades off the floor

movement.measure: angle of the straight legs above the floor
arm elevation (180 = along the spine overhead)

movement.path: Still; lumbar flat (spine05 small flexion, never extension).

muscles.emg: No EMG study of the gymnastics hollow hold found (searched; 'abdominal hollowing' studies are a different, drawing-in manoeuvre). Closest: V-sit hold ~80% MVIC RA (Maeo, in S2).
muscles.role: Holds the rib cage curled to the pelvis and the low back flat against the lever of arms and legs.
muscles.surface: Vertical bands down the front of the belly.

mistakes.mistake: Low back arching off the floor
mistakes.what_it_looks_like: A gap appears under the low back, legs too low.
mistakes.why_it_matters: ACE: the back must stay pressed down; an arch loads the spine instead of the abs.

mistakes.mistake: Arms dropped to the sides / chin tucked hard
mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Arms by the hips or head cranked forward.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Loses the hollow shape; not the textbook position.

sources.citation: Jo S (ACE). 10-Minute Core Workout: Hollow-body Rock (ACE blog).
sources.what_it_gave: Hollow-body position: legs extended, arms overhead biceps by the ears, glutes/inner thighs/abs squeezed, low back pushed into the floor with no space.

sources.citation: Oliva-Lozano JM, Muyor JM. 2020. Core muscle activity during physical fitness exercises: a systematic review. Int J Environ Res Public Health 17(12):4306. doi:10.3390/ijerph17124306

clip_check.check: Low back / pelvis on the floor, no arch
clip_check.target: lowest point -0.002..+0.002 m at the sacrum; spine05 >= 0
knee 0-15; leg line 5-20 deg; heels 0.15-0.35 m up
